statics.note: Independent reviewer, round 2: 9/10 (round 1: 7, hook 'Stock ten packets in one yellow box.' too close to the used 'Garden shops: ten packets, one shelf-ready box.'; hook rewritten, image unchanged). Three boxes upright, tab centered on the bottom short end of the front box, print correct, chalkboard blank, bell and plants are scenery; claims in Product facts (MOQ 10, 14-day delivery, packed in the USA), no wholesale price stated; wholesale email CTA intentional. Nit: spine lettering on the two rear boxes is partly garbled and out of focus.

statics.note: Independent reviewer, round 1: 8/10. Drawer slides lengthwise out of the short end, full width, black foam, grow guide picture-only, tab centered on the drawer's short front (matches the real frames); print correct; four fanned packets each a different bold colour (purple turnip, green leaf, pink Chioggia beet, orange carrot), one vegetable each, no words; claims in Product facts; hook 5 words. Reservation: 'Ten named packets' is lifted from a used hook and the line reads a little like a spec sheet.
